sources.title: Sources

responses.title: Email responses

referrals.title: Referrals
referrals.schema: CREATE TABLE ("Request" TITLE, "Person" RICH_TEXT, "Company" RICH_TEXT, "Contact role" RICH_TEXT, "LinkedIn" URL, "Job" RELATION('{{jobs_data_source_id}}'), "Status" SELECT('Draft':gray, 'Sent':blue, 'Replied':purple, 'Referred':green, 'Closed':gray, 'Needs attention':orange), "Message draft" RICH_TEXT, "Why this person" RICH_TEXT, "Input needed" RICH_TEXT, "Next action" RICH_TEXT, "Last contact" DATE, "Reply" RICH_TEXT, "Evidence URL" URL, "Checked" DATE, "Request key" RICH_TEXT, "Account" URL, "CV version" RICH_TEXT)

actions.What it does: Master switch for new applications. Requires a channel switch and live mode. Shared limit: 5/day.
Submit employer website forms. Does not enable email, Telegram or replies.
Read Telegram vacancies and messages. Does not allow sending.
Send a first application to a verified Telegram hiring contact. Requires master switch.
Reply in an existing, matched Telegram hiring conversation. Separate from new applications.
Read hiring emails and sync verified responses to Notion. Mailbox labeling is optional and separately authorized.
Send a first application to a verified employer email address. Requires master switch.
Reply to an existing, matched hiring email. Gmail sending is not connected.
Send reminders after an unanswered application. Not implemented; keep Off.
Send referral requests to verified first-degree LinkedIn connections. Sending is not implemented; keep Off.

profile.title: My profile & CV
profile.content:
## CV
Add your accessible English CV link here.

## Search preferences
Target roles, countries, work formats and compensation.

## Confirmed facts
Contact details, location, work authorization, sponsorship and notice period.

## Missing information
Record unknown required answers here; do not invent them.

Sending is off.
